headline: Kanohar Electricals updates contact details of key managerial personnel
hook: Routine compliance filing on contact updates
summary: Kanohar Electricals has officially informed the stock exchanges about updated contact details for its Key Managerial Personnel. This update is executed in compliance with Regulation 30(5) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements. Such administrative filings are standard corporate governance procedures. Indian retail investors are unlikely to experience any financial or operational impact from this disclosure.
why_it_matters: No financial impact on your investments
